2.114 ChartAnnotations
Applies to RDL 2008/01
The ChartAnnotations element is ignored.
Following are the parent and child elements of the ChartAnnotations element.
Parent elements
Chart
Child elements
ChartAnnotations.ChartAnnotation
The following is the XML Schema definition of the ChartAnnotations element.
 <xsd:complexType name="ChartAnnotationType">
    <xsd:sequence>
       <xsd:element name="ChartAnnotation" type="ChartAnnotationType" maxOccurs="unbounded" />
    </xsd:sequence>
  </xsd:complexType>
